changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: account_public_activity_hidden_by_default already exists; this changeset creates it

changeSet.comment: The accounts that the next change set hides only because they never answered, so that its rollback restores exactly those accounts.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Public activity pages hide a person until they answer. An account that is still visible and has no workspace answer is visible only by the old default, so it becomes hidden. A Show saved only in User settings counts as no answer. Workspace answers stay as they are, and nothing writes these rows again. One statement hides and records each account, so no write can land between the two.
changeSet.sql: WITH hidden AS ( UPDATE account a SET public_activity_visible = false WHERE a.public_activity_visible AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM membership m WHERE m.account_id = a.id AND m.public_activity_seen) RETURNING a.id ) INSERT INTO account_public_activity_hidden_by_default (account_id) SELECT id FROM hidden
